children: Finnair carried 1.13 million passengers in August, up 2.3% from a year earlier and compared with 1.24 million passengers in July.

The Finnish flag carrier said Tuesday that passenger numbers grew in European traffic but declined in North Atlantic and domestic traffic, while flights to the Middle East were suspended on Feb. 28 due to the situation in the region.
The total cargo weight it carried increased by 2% on year, as European cargo traffic in particular saw significant growth.
Overall capacity in August decreased by 4.8% on year, while traffic decreased 3.1%.
